title: Isotropic submanifolds of $T\mathbb{S}^n$ and their focal sets
summary: Families of oriented lines in $\mathbb{R}^{n+1}$ are studied via their identification with submanifolds of $T\mathbb{S}^n$. In particular, families of oriented lines which are orthogonal to submanifolds in $\mathbb{R}^{n+1}$ are shown to characterise those which are isotropic with respect to the canonical sympleptic structure on $T\mathbb{S}^n$. Families of lines that are tangent to a $k$-dimensional submanifold of $\mathbb{R}^{n+1}$ are then studied.
